subject: STABLE: kernel 0096 userspace (GPU-only allocs, IOSurface acquire, stale-line fake); HEAVY RELEASE; A/B-disable answer; f204 handed to texture agent
body: Gates green: run_host_tests 57 PASS up to the known probe step; integration 1005 (only the known CA stride check); render harness; CA test PF0/PF1. Bridge: ALLOC flags bit1 GPU-only for the persistent tiler heap (unless the geometry trace maps it), graphics TLS, compute TLS/WLS; the tiler matrix now uses its own mapped 16 MiB heap and drops it, so the probe's persistent heap is GPU-only after the matrix (the 16 MiB per-job clean+invalidate from README-0095-0096 goes away). Heap size is the adopted tiler size (2 MiB unless the matrix adopts 16 MiB), no longer HEAP_MATRIX by default. map_bo refuses GPU-only BOs; n2mb_scalar(1) accepts {bytes, flags} with only bit1 (client GPU-only), n2mb_gpu_only_state() reports 1 accepted / 2 refused. Old kernel: the first refused bit1 alloc is retried plain and remembered. IOSurface audit: bridge n2mb_copy read an imported source without an acquire -> now SYNC(to CPU) first; the feedback snapshot already SYNCs. Frontend (no edit): getBytes/replaceRegion on imported textures, tegu_shadow_copy, pixel probe and grid trace all lock/unlock correctly; no other CPU access to imported surfaces found. Fake kernel: GPU-only flag (maps refused), no_gpu_only (old kernel) and a stale-surface model (GPU view vs CPU lines, refreshed only by an acquire); the new test fails without the n2mb_copy acquire. Hashes: 6679a650 metal/nord2_metal_bridge.c; 2fc13b22 metal/nord2_metal_bridge.h; d173eec1 tests/nord2_metal_bridge_test.c;  RECOMMENDATION (frontend, encode/texture owner): every TeguBuffer/texture BO is mapped at creation (compute_frontend.m newBufferWithLength), so every client buffer is CPU-visible at level 1 and maintained on every job (render targets incl. 565x1220 blur targets). Map lazily on first CPU access (tegu_buffer_bytes) so private (options 0x20) targets that only the GPU touches stay invisible; GPU-only is only safe where no CPU blit/readback can follow. A/B disables (c6k ui350 log): PREFRAME (phase 3, line 7497) and NATIVE_INDEXED=0 (phase 7, line 8574) were each preceded by the same ASTC_4x4 refusal (indexed_native resp. indexed_expand, rc=-6, src f204) -> not the features. ASYNC_PIPELINE (phase 9, line 10939): no record, because TEGU_COMMAND_FAILED is capped at 16 per process and was exhausted by then; most likely the same ASTC class (app opening). Ask: raise that cap or log per A/B phase so the next run attributes every disable. f204/ASTC profile fix (already committed? files metal/tegu/build_compute_bundle.py astc_ldr_profile + tools/build_tegu_frontend_objects.sh) now belongs to the texture agent per root; I will not touch descriptor/format code.
